run_biencoder_evaluation: run the biencoder evaluation script to evaluate a BiEncoderRanker model on test data and get top-k predictions
load_entity_dict: load an entity dictionary from a JSON lines file containing title and text fields into a list of tuples
get_candidate_pool_tensor: convert a list of entity descriptions into tokenized tensor representations using a BERT tokenizer
encode_candidate: encode a candidate pool tensor into embeddings using a BiEncoderRanker model in batched mode
load_or_generate_candidate_pool: load a pre-generated candidate pool from disk or generate one from an entity dictionary and save it
